text: What if all plastic disappeared for five seconds? Bad news. Your drink just hit the floor.
Every bottle, every tub. Milk, ketchup, shampoo. Splat. Your fridge is a swamp.
Half of your car is plastic. Dashboard, steering wheel. Gone. Good thing you're in traffic.
Every cable loses its insulation. Copper hits copper. Sparks. Blackout.
Every plastic chair vanishes. The whole office hits the floor.
The pipes in your walls? Gone. Water shoots out of the ceiling. Don't ask about the toilet.
Plastic is back. Your bottle too. Empty.
Somewhere, a guy is sitting in a puddle in a dark office. Alive. And done with Mondays.
What should disappear next? Say it in the comments, or I pick something worse.
